competitors.title: C1 Autonomous Worker — Put AI to work. On your permissions.
key_points: Built for long-horizon tasks, carries multi-step jobs from start to finish without losing thread
Pass-through authorization scopes every request to exactly what its user can access, enforced in real time at C1's identity-aware gateway
Every action is fully auditable, logged and attributed for compliance

Four-step workflow: Ask (plain language in Slack/console) → Plan (breaks job into steps) → Act (writes/runs code under permissions, routes sensitive changes to human) → Done (finished result with audit log)
95% of companies already have AI agents doing autonomous work, but only 21% have set policy for what agents are allowed to do (C1 2026 Future of Identity Report)
Average Fortune 500 will run 150,000+ AI agents by 2028, up from fewer than 15 today (Gartner, April 2026)

competitors.title: C1 Launches C1 Autonomous Worker, a Governed AI Agent for Enterprise Identity Work (Press Release, June 15, 2026)
key_points: First AI agent purpose-built for enterprise identity governance
Can revoke stale admin grants in Snowflake, build quarterly access reviews, pull audit evidence, find deactivated users still listed as entitlement owners
Governed by same policy engine that governs human users — can only do what its operator is permitted to do
CEO Alex Bovee: 'C1AW executes code, acts through your real permissions, and runs jobs from start to finish without handing them back to you'
Future vision: workers that run on their own (scheduled security agent), one control plane for every agent, govern context and execution
Available now to all C1 customers, enabled by default when C1 Slack app is installed

competitors.title: C1 Debuts Autonomous AI Worker for Enterprise Identity Management (Pure AI, June 15, 2026)
key_points: AI-powered agent designed to automate identity and access management tasks across enterprise environments
Handles routine identity operations: access requests, approvals, provisioning, and governance processes
Operates within predefined security and compliance policies
Can check for policy gaps, govern context and execution, controlled centrally with one control plane for every agent
Built to function alongside existing identity infrastructure, executes tasks through programmatic interfaces

competitors.title: C1 Launches C1 Autonomous Worker, a Governed AI Agent for Enterprise Identity Work (VMblog, June 15, 2026)
key_points: C1AW is the first AI agent purpose-built for enterprise identity governance
Every action governed by same policy engine as human users, attributed in C1's audit trail
Future: scheduled autonomous workers, unified control plane for multi-vendor agent ecosystems
Governs not just what an agent can see, but what context it receives and how far its execution can reach
